'''Koyasu Shrine''' (子安神社) is a type of {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} primarily dedicated to deities associated with [[safe childbirth]] and [[:en:child-rearing|child-rearing]].

Shrines are generally divided into those enshrining [[Konohanasakuya-hime]], who is also the deity of {{ill|Mount Fuji|abstract|Q39231|af|Foedji|am|ፉጂ ተራራ|an|Mont Fuji|ang|Fucgi Beorg|ar|جبل فوجي|arz|جبل فوجى|as|মাউণ্ট ফুজি|ast|Monte Fuji|az|Fuci|azb|فوجی‌یاما|ba|Фудзияма|ban|Gunung Fuji|bcl|Bukid Fuji|be|Фудзіяма|be_x_old|Фудзіяма|bew|Gunung Puji|bg|Фуджи|bn|ফুজি পর্বত|br|Menez Fuji|bs|Fuji|btm|Gunung Fujiama|ca|Mont Fuji|ceb|Fujiyama|ckb|چیای فوجی|cs|Fudži|cy|Mynydd Fuji|da|Fuji|de|Fuji (Vulkan)|dv|ފުޖީ ފަރުބަދަ|el|Φούτζι|eo|Monto Fuĵi|es|Monte Fuji|et|Fuji|eu|Fuji mendia|fa|کوه فوجی|fi|Fuji (vuori)|fr|Mont Fuji|frr|Fuji|ga|Sliabh Fuji|gan|富士山|gl|Monte Fuji|gn|Hujisã|hak|Fuji-sân|he|הר פוג'י|hi|फ़ूजीयामा|hr|Fuji|hu|Fudzsi|hy|Ֆուձիյամա|ia|Monte Fuji|iba|Gunung Fuji|id|Gunung Fuji|ie|Monte Fuji|io|Fujiyama|is|Fuji|it|Fuji (monte)|ja|富士山|jv|Gunung Fuji|ka|ფუძიამა|ki|Kĩrĩma gĩa Bunji|kk|Фудзияма|km|ភ្នំហ្វឹជី|kn|ಮೌಂಟ್ ಫುಜಿ|ko|후지산|ku|Çiyayê Fuji|ky|Фужи тоосу|la|Mons Fuji|lld|Mont Fuji|lmo|Fuji|lo|ພູເຂົາຟູຈິ|lt|Fudzijama|lv|Fudzi|mk|Фуџи|ml|ഫുജി പർവ്വതം|mn|Фүжи уул|mr|माउंट फुजी|ms|Gunung Fuji|mt|Fuji|my|ဖူဂျီတောင်|mzn|فوجی یاما|ne|फुजी हिमाल|nl|Fuji (vulkaan)|nn|Fuji-fjellet|no|Fuji-san|oc|Mont Fuji|or|ଫୁଜି ପର୍ବତ|os|Фудзиямæ|pa|ਮਾਊਂਟ ਫੂਜੀ|pam|Bunduk Fuji|pl|Fudżi|pms|Mont Fuji|pnb|فیوجی|pt|Monte Fuji|ro|Fuji|ru|Фудзияма|sat|ᱢᱟᱣᱩᱱᱴ ᱯᱷᱩᱡᱤ|sc|Monte Fuji|scn|Fujiama|sco|Moont Fuji|sh|Fuji|si|ෆූජි කන්ද|simple|Mount Fuji|sk|Fudžisan|sl|Fudži|so|Buurka Jabaan Fuji|sq|Fuxhi|sr|Fudži|su|Gunung Fuji|sv|Fuji|sw|Mlima Fuji|szl|Fuji (berg)|szy|Bu-s buyu’|ta|பூஜி மலை|te|ఫ్యూజీ పర్వతం|th|ภูเขาฟูจิ|tl|Bundok Fuji|tok|nena Pusi|tr|Fuji Dağı|tt|Фудзияма|uk|Фудзі (гора)|ur|کوہ فیوجی|uz|Fudziyama|vi|Phú Sĩ|war|Bukid Fuji|wuu|富士山|xmf|ფუძიამა|zh|富士山|zh_classical|富士山|zh_min_nan|Hù-sū-san|zh_yue|富士山|qid=Q39231|lt=Mount Fuji}} (and the main deity of [[:en:Sengen Shrine|Sengen Shrine]]), and those enshrining [[Kushinadahime]], the wife of [[Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Susanoo]]. Both deities are genealogically related, with the former being the child and the latter being the grandchild of [[Ōyamatsumi]].
